name: The Performance Review
description: A stern clipboard with a bar-chart face. Pulls back, then charges with papers flying.
subject: An oversized anthropomorphic warm brown clipboard/report-card boss with thick cream paper, a teal clip at top, four bold bar-chart columns on its belly and stern-but-comical navy eyes/eyebrows above the chart. Tiny navy office-trouser legs and brown loafers under the clipboard, short navy arms with cream paper-tab hands. The six-frame walk is a slightly pompous waddle with alternating feet, body lean and paper corners bouncing. WIND-UP 6: draws back and leans away from the charge, arms brace, the chart bars turn coral red #C45C4B. WIND-UP 7: pulls back even farther with compressed knees, all four chart bars coral-red, eyebrows raised like a terrible review is about to arrive. ATTACK 8: thrusts clipboard forward diagonally left toward the viewer in a clear lunge with one extended leg and two cream paper sheets flying within the cell. ATTACK 9: follows through with opposite foot forward and bent paper corners. HURT 10: startled wince, cream highlight on the clipboard rim, loose paper corner folded inward. No lettering or numbers.

name: The 30-Year Mortgage
description: A heavy house riding a contract stack. Stamps down to send compounding-interest shockwaves.
subject: An oversized walking mortgage: squat cream-and-teal suburban house with warm rusty-red roof atop a VERY thick stack of cream contract pages, a curled contract corner and a bold percentage-sign seal. Navy eyebrows and sleepy determined eyes in the house windows, two short massive navy legs with heavy brown shoes. Read as house plus crushing paper weight, never as a human. Six-frame walk shows heavy alternating footfalls, contract stack compressing a little and roof bobbing, constant proportions. WIND-UP 6: one heavy foot rises and house leans back, percentage seal brightens cream/coral. WIND-UP 7: house lifts onto the other foot with a clearly raised stamp-like sole and compressed contract stack. ATTACK 8: heavy foot stamps down and stack squashes, two small cream floor-impact paper curls and two small % glyphs inside cell. ATTACK 9: weight settles into a low ground-slam pose, roof and pages flex. HURT 10: windows squeeze into a wince and a folded roof corner lifts, strong cream highlight clusters. No text or numbers except the explicitly requested % symbol.

name: The Midlife Crisis V8
description: A red convertible with too much confidence. Revs, then slides sideways into a drift.
subject: An oversized cherry/coral RED sports convertible, cream windshield rim and headlights, deep navy glass/seats/tires, coffee-orange exhaust accents. Car has comically determined headlight eyes and a grille mouth, playful toy-like chunky proportions, no human driver, no logos. Show the long hood from top-down 3/4 front-left, nose aimed down-left toward viewer, filling almost the full native frame height with a strong broad red silhouette. WALK frames 0–5 are a six-frame DRIVING idle cycle, NEVER legs: rotating spoke phases, alternating one-pixel engine bob, suspension compression and small changing exhaust puffs, consistent silhouette and car scale. WIND-UP 6: rear suspension squats, rear tires wind up and a small pale-cream exhaust puff emerges. WIND-UP 7: car leans into the coming drift with two pale-cream exhaust puffs, front wheels turn. ATTACK 8: sliding sideways at a new angle, turned front wheels and small hard-pixel tire-smoke puffs. ATTACK 9: slide follows through farther with a clearly different body angle, opposite suspension compressed. Keep both sliding poses fully inside same maximum cell width. HURT 10: headlights wince and hood creases with cream highlight clusters. No tire-track ground decal in the sheet, that is a separate asset. No text or logos.
